title: Additions
description: Random items and blocks to enhance your worlds.
body: Howdy! Welcome to Additions. In this mod, you will find a ton of random *additions* to enhance your playing experience in Minecraft. From new biomes and wood, to soups and instruments, to new nuts and building blocks, to new teas and spices, this mod has just about everything missing from Minecraft. Thank you for installing Additions by Scarlons!
